_readme: S713 (worker for SkyKittiwake), census lever 4 (City College of San Francisco, page not found, 53). Free page read 45129229734 printed every page up to 480 of the 2026-27 catalog PDF (920 pages; the program pages and the career-pathway index, pp.431-442, sit inside that span) that names one of the 53 titles. Seven have their own heading and are pinned in the college's reconcile entry (pdf_pages: 09178, 17952, 17954, 31602, 36964, 42318, 45768). The other 46 are filed here: 18 credit programs and 27 noncredit programs no page prints under a heading of their own title (the index names none of them), and Microsoft Office Specialist 24263 (noncredit), whose only page is the credit certificate 40432's. No model call, no Supabase write: no row exists for these programs, and the capture holds no text for them. They are the college's to settle in COCI.
